You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `core/src/main/java/org/apache/accumulo/core/util/shell/Shell.java`**
   - The code modification changes the formatting of the authorization timeout from a floating-point representation to a decimal integer representation.
   - Specifically, the line:
     ```java
     sb.append("- Authorization timeout: ").append(String.format("%.2fs%n", TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toSeconds(authTimeout)));
     ```
     was modified to:
     ```java
     sb.append("- Authorization timeout: ").append(String.format("%ds%n", TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toSeconds(authTimeout)));
     ```
   - This change ensures that the authorization timeout is displayed as whole seconds rather than as a floating point with two decimal places.

### Relationships

The modification in the `Shell.java` file relates to the proper display of the authorization timeout information within the shell interface of the Accumulo system. By changing the format from floating-point to integer, the patch improves clarity and consistency in presenting timeout values, which are inherently whole seconds, thus enhancing user understanding and experience while using the shell.
